title: Women's 200m World Rankings: November 2026
desc: The top ten in World Athletics' women's 200m event ranking as of 3 November 2026. Values are ranking points, not race times; associated indoor 200m short-track performances can contribute. This dated snapshot covers only the top ten and the live source may change.

source.name: World Athletics — Women’s 200m World Rankings
source.note: Verified by the AllRanks assistant (Codex) on 2026-11-09 against directly retrieved official HTML (HTTP 200). Compared all ten athlete names, places 1–10, countries, ranking points and 3 November 2026 edition. Page one contains 100 athletes; only the top ten are included. IOC codes mapped to ISO-2: USA/US, LCA/LC, GBR/GB, JAM/JM, BAH/BS, IVB/VG. Associated indoor 200m short-track performances may contribute (Hodge lists 200m sh). Points are not race times or independent tests. The live source may change.
